(Currently Amended) 2) Composition according to Claim 1 wherein the compound of formula I is an indole compound of the formula 5-(7-methoxy-3,3-dimethyl-2,3-dihydro-1-benzoxepin-5-yl)-3-methyl-penta-2,4-dienoic and/or a physiologically acceptable salt thereof.

(Currently Amended) 3) Composition for topical use comprising a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1 or 2, b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action, wherein the active ingredient is specifically indicated for the treatment of skin diseases.

(Currently Amended) 4) Composition according to one or more of the Claim 1 or 3, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0.00001 per cent by weight to 10 per cent by weight, specifically for the treatment of skin conditions.

(Currently Amended) 6) Composition according to claim 5, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient 5 ectoine, preferably in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight, more preferably 0.1 to 5 per cent by weight and especially 0.1 to 2 per cent by weight, for enhancing skin condition.

(Currently Amended) 7) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition specifically formulated for skin conditions.

(Currently Amended) 8) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the preparation of a composition which is suitable for the prophylaxis and/or treatment of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation, specifically for the treatment of acne vulgaris and other related skin conditions.

(Currently Amended) 9) Use according to Claim 8 for hair care and/or hair follicle development, specifically targeting conditions related to hair health.

(Currently Amended) 10) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the care, preservation or improvement of the general state of the skin or hair, specifically addressing skin health.

(Currently Amended) 11) Use of active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 as skin lightening and/or skin whitening active agent, specifically for improving skin tone.

(Currently Amended) 12) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 or 2 for skin lightening and/or skin whitening, specifically targeting uneven skin tone.

(Currently Amended) 13) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the prophylaxis against or reduction of skin unevenness, such as wrinkles, fine lines, rough skin or large-pored skin, specifically for skin rejuvenation.

(Currently Amended) 14) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the prophylaxis against time- and/or light-induced ageing processes of the human skin or human hair, specifically for the prevention of dry skin and wrinkle formation.
